title: Sector
description: A sector object, as found in SECTORS[*]

x.description: The number of screens from the left of the Sector map to the left edge of the Sector.

y.description: The number of screens from the top of the Sector map to the top edge of the Sector.

width.description: The number of screens wide the Sector is. Also affects the in-sector map of Areas.

height.description: The number of screens tall the Sector is. Also affects the in-sector map of Areas.

connections.description: A list of sector Ids for other Sectors this Sector has teleport connections to.

x.description: The x coordinate of the elevator screen relative to the Sector x.

y.description: The y coordinate of the elevator screen relative to the Sector y.
